correctness.rationale: For every zero-labeled vertex in part i, the exact number of adjacent 2-labels is T-t_i. Thus feasibility is equivalent to T-t_i=1 on every zero-containing part. The resulting case split by T is exhaustive and disjoint, and each generating-function term is a direct binomial count. A definition-level checker independently verifies all coefficients and the minimum formula through order nine.

value.rationale: The complete multipartite family is a canonical dense cograph class. The result supplies information absent from minimum-only algorithms: every feasible structural regime, every weight coefficient, and a closed minimum formula. The 2024 enumeration literature independently motivates exact function enumeration as a substantive object.
